notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Discover Pirates: Rogue's Fortune!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Ahoy, future captains![/b][/h3][p]We’re thrilled to officially announce [b]Pirates: Rogue’s Fortune[/b] and finally share with you [b]a first glimpse of the adventure[/b].[/p][p]Our very first teaser is available now! [b]Discover an action and adventure rogue-lite[/b] where every attempt brings you closer to becoming a legend: [/p][list][*][p][b]Explore the ocean depths[/b] in search of treasures ⚓ [/p][/*][*][p][b]Face waves of fearsome enemies[/b] as you resurface ⚔[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrade your ship and arsenal[/b] to become the ultimate pirate ⛵[/p][/*][/list][p]
📺 [b]Watch the teaser here:[/b][/p][previewyoutube="gt5I0uad1yY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Pirates: Rogue’s Fortune[/b] will be available in [b]Early Access[/b] in early 2026, and we can’t wait to sail with you to refine every detail thanks to your feedback.[/p][p]At Ninpô, we’re a small independent team chasing a big dream, and your support means the world to us! [b]Add the game to your wishlist and share it with your friends...[/b] It only takes a few seconds, but it helps us more than you can imagine. Thank you in advance!
[/p][p]💛 [b]Add the game to your wishlist now:[/b] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423280/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We’ll regularly share development updates, exclusive previews, and we’re eager to hear your thoughts. The adventure is just beginning![/p][p][/p][p]— The [b]NINPÔ Game Studio[/b] crew[/p][p][/p]
